bio.text: Jake Johnson, a teacher, is the DFL candidate for Minnesota's 1st Congressional District in 2026, facing Republican Rep. Brad Finstad in the general election.
He grew up in Stewartville, attended the University of Wisconsin-La Crosse, and has taught math in Rochester Public Schools, according to KIMT's 2025 report on his campaign launch.

sources.title: Minnesota congressional races set after Tuesday primary. Here's who is running in each district
Rochester educator is running for Congress
